# sofascore_scraper.store.StoreInfo
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/api.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StoreInfo:
    data_dir: str
    readonly: bool
    store_id: str
    layout_version: int
    min_reader_layout: int
    manifest_format: int
    created_by: str
    created_at: str
    last_writer: Mapping[str, Any]
    state_schema: int
    catalog_schema: Optional[int]
    derive_version: Optional[int]
    catalog_rebuild_reason: Optional[str]
    last_rebuild: Optional[str]
    journal_modes: Mapping[str, str]
    rows: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, int]]
    events_by_layout: Mapping[str, int]
    bytes: Mapping[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    leases: Tuple[LeaseInfo, ...] = ()
